evidence: Touches descriptor interfaces (key and descriptor management) in `src/script/descriptor.h` and `src/script/descriptor.cpp` to enable standalone key expression parsing for wallet setup flows.
rationale: Exposes `ParsePubkey` and `PubkeyProvider` to allow wallet flows to validate and inspect standalone key expressions without constructing full descriptors, unblocking the multisig wizard (#35645). It also resolves a minor parser bug in `musig()` where trailing characters were silently ignored.
